case.summary: Customer C08623 disputes a $49.00 in-person charge (3530164) in region 330 on 2016-12-10. Everything structural points the other way: the channel, product, region and amount are all core to this card's 980-transaction baseline, the card has 42 prior transactions in region 330 including four days in the past week, and the same $49 amount has been charged 56 times across all six months of history. The customer has genuine prior fraud on this card, but every confirmed case was out-of-region card-present use or mixed-channel takeover — neither signature is present here, and there are no online transactions, no testing runs and no new device in the window. The rare-device and region-cluster links are too weak to attach (33 cards all-time on the device profile; no device recorded on the flagged transaction). Treat as a likely misrecognised recurring charge: open a case, verify with the customer and warn them, do not block.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer, shown the merchant and the 56 prior same-amount charges at this location, recognises the $49.00 purchase as their own routine spend and withdraws the dispute.
